name: Puffco | Proxy 3D Chamber
description: The 3D Chamber is a game changer. This innovative ceramic bowl uses patented technology to preserve terpenes and cannabinoids. As you inhale, heating traces vaporize your extract on the sides of the chamber – not the bottom – so you can enjoy bigger, better tasting hits.
